PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8083/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($r\) { "StatusCode: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } else { "Failed to connect" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8001/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($r\) { "StatusCode: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } else { "Failed to connect" })

PowerShell($alertas = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing; $first = \($alertas.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\)[0]; $id = $first.id; Write-Host "Borrando alerta ID: $id"; $del = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/alertas/$id" -Method DELETE -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Status DELETE: $\($del.StatusCode\)"; $after = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Alertas antes: $\($first.id -ne $null\), despues count incluye ID: $\(\($after | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id }\).Count -eq 0\)")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Total en historial: $\($data.Count\)"; $data | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $\($_.mensaje.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(60, $_.mensaje.Length\)\)\)..." })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Total en historial: $\($data.Count\)"; $data | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ tipo=$_.tipoAlerta; fecha=$_.fechaEnvio; msg=\($_.mensaje.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(40,$_.mensaje.Length\)\)\) } } | Select-Object -First 6 | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/alertas" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) — $\($data.Count\) alertas en historial")
